# CLI Surface Evidence

<!-- Generated by go run ./tools/clisurface -write-doc. Do not edit by hand. -->

Executable SSOT: [`cli-surface.riido.json`](cli-surface.riido.json).

Evidence artifact: `cli-surface-evidence`.

Keeps the public cmd/riido command surface generated from a manifest and verified against black-box CLI output plus source boundaries.

## Command Groups

| Group | Subcommands | Owner | Boundary | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `work` | `get`, `tree`, `relations`, `comments`, `activity`, `search` | cmd/riido, internal/contextcli | reads Riido work items through the local daemon broker (agent mode) or the signed-in user credential (user mode); opens no listener | `main-command-work`, `work-subcommand-vocabulary` |
| `context` | `get`, `changes` | cmd/riido, internal/contextcli | returns the base work-context bundle and snapshot changes under the same mode rules as work | `main-command-context`, `context-subcommand-vocabulary` |
| `meeting` | `list`, `get` | cmd/riido, internal/contextcli | lists connected meeting metadata or reads a captured meeting document within the assignment snapshot through the run-authorized daemon broker | `main-command-meeting`, `meeting-subcommand-vocabulary` |
| `agents` | `list`, `show` | cmd/riido, internal/contextcli | lists or shows the agents the run's requester can see, read live through the same daemon broker for choosing whom to mention; never invokes an agent | `main-command-agents`, `agents-subcommand-vocabulary` |
| `auth` | `login`, `logout`, `status` | cmd/riido, internal/contextcli | user-mode sign-in state; never accepts secrets as arguments and never prints credentials | `main-command-auth`, `auth-subcommand-vocabulary` |
| `whoami` | _none_ | cmd/riido, internal/contextcli | reports the acting principal, workspace, and mode without printing secrets | `main-command-whoami` |
| `doctor` | _none_ | cmd/riido, internal/contextcli | local diagnosis of binary, PATH, mode, daemon IPC, and auth state; remote API verification is unsupported and --check-api exits 8 without making a remote read | `main-command-doctor` |
| `capabilities` | _none_ | cmd/riido, internal/contextcli | static description of CLI, envelope, and IPC schema versions plus command availability | `main-command-capabilities` |
| `serve` | _none_ | internal/riidoapi | local IPC server over Unix socket or Windows named pipe | `main-command-serve`, `run-serve-dispatch` |
| `api` | `status`, `tasks`, `review-demo`, `transition`, `evidence`, `validate` | internal/riidoapi | local IPC client for guarded task and status APIs | `main-command-api`, `api-subcommand-vocabulary` |
| `mwsd` | `snapshot`, `projection`, `sync`, `orchestration`, `projects`, `status` | internal/mwsdbridge, internal/project, internal/taskdb | reads MWSD snapshots and promotes local workspace/task projections | `main-command-mwsd`, `mwsd-subcommand-vocabulary` |
| `task` | `list`, `transition`, `evidence`, `validate` | internal/taskdb, internal/validation | local guarded task mutation, evidence, and validation over JSON task DB | `main-command-task`, `task-subcommand-vocabulary` |
| `bridge` | `providers`, `detect` | provider adapter packages | provider list/detect smoke surface without executing provider tasks | `main-command-bridge`, `bridge-subcommand-vocabulary` |
| `version` | _none_ | cmd/riido release artifact identity | binary release tag evidence without daemon IPC | `main-command-version`, `run-version-dispatch` |
| `daemon` | `start`, `status`, `health`, `ready`, `metrics`, `stop`, `logs` | internal/agentbridge/runtimeactor, supervisor, control-plane adapters | local runtime lifecycle, health, readiness, metrics, stop, and logs | `main-command-daemon`, `daemon-subcommand-vocabulary` |

## Provider Smoke Surface

`riido bridge providers` must expose: `claude`, `codex`, `openclaw`, `cursor`.

## Assertions

- cmd/riido remains local-only and must not open public TCP or HTTP listeners
- usage output must expose each declared command group
- bridge providers output must expose the provider vocabulary without launching provider tasks
- work-context commands must reject secrets passed as arguments and keep the envelope on stdout
